text: RESULTS: Vital Signs: Temperature 38.3°C (100.9°F), Heart Rate 120/min, Respiratory Rate 30/min. General Examination: Patient appears pale and fatigued; cervical and axillary lymphadenopathy detected. Abdominal Examination: Liver palpable 3 cm below the right costal margin; spleen palpable 2 cm below the left costal margin; abdomen is soft and nontender. Complete Blood Count: Hemoglobin 10.1 g/dL, Leukocyte Count 63,000/mm3 (elevated), Platelet Count 27,000/mm3 (decreased). text: The elevated white blood cell count, severe bone pain, and bone marrow findings of immature cells positive for CD10, CD19, and TdT strongly indicate a specific type of leukemia.
